title: Atomic first-user bootstrap
failure_mode: Concurrent setup creates multiple initial users or leaves temporary-superuser state after a partial write.
trigger_or_prerequisite: First-user requests race or record creation/deletion fails.
affected_data_security_functionality: Account privilege boundary and Hub administration.
mitigation: Preserve transaction boundary; prove exactly-one creation and rollback on each failure point.
required_test: Race bootstrap requests and inject failures at each write/delete.
rollback_containment_action: Keep Hub offline; restore pre-upgrade DB and old binary if account state is inconsistent.

title: Trusted proxy IP allowlisting
failure_mode: Forwarded identity is trusted from an untrusted peer or valid trusted-header auth unexpectedly fails closed.
trigger_or_prerequisite: TRUSTED_AUTH_HEADER is used with unset, empty, malformed, or restricted TRUSTED_PROXY_IPS.
mitigation: Test unset/empty behavior separately from valid CIDRs and invalid-only configuration; document actual proxy ranges.
required_test: Direct/proxied request matrix across allow/deny and malformed CIDRs.
rollback_containment_action: Disable trusted-header auth or restrict external access until old behavior is restored.

title: OAuth role assignment
failure_mode: New OAuth account receives an elevated role.
trigger_or_prerequisite: OAuth creates a new user or links an existing account.
mitigation: New OAuth users start as role=user; existing roles remain unchanged.
required_test: Create/link OAuth users and assert role plus system access.
rollback_containment_action: Disable OAuth/user creation until the security path is restored.

title: v0.20 PocketBase collection snapshot
failure_mode: Snapshot omits or changes an existing field, rule, index, or migration ledger entry.
trigger_or_prerequisite: Existing 0.19 DB enters v0.20 snapshot path with a prior one-off migration present or absent.
affected_data_security_functionality: Accounts, settings, systems, alerts, history, schema, and access rules.
mitigation: Migrate disposable 0.19 copies; compare schemas, migration ledger, IDs, values, counts, and second-start idempotence.
required_test: 0.19→0.21 fixture migration with interruption and restart.
rollback_containment_action: Stop both services and restore full snapshot plus old binary; never open partial DB with 0.19.

title: Network monitor resync after SSH reconnect
failure_mode: Monitor configuration stays stale after SSH reconnect or a failed sync is not retried.
trigger_or_prerequisite: SSH reconnect occurs after monitor edits or an earlier sync failure.
mitigation: Retry pending sync without failing stats collection; empty replace set must clear removed probes.
required_test: Reconnect with changed, removed, empty monitor sets and forced first sync failure.
rollback_containment_action: Disable affected monitor until configuration converges.

title: Slow collection WebSocket reconnect loop
failure_mode: A healthy slow Agent is repeatedly disconnected during collection.
trigger_or_prerequisite: Disk/pool collection exceeds former data deadline.
mitigation: Keep cache locking and do not close a healthy connection solely on data deadline.
required_test: Delay collection beyond former timeout; verify one connection and eventual data.
rollback_containment_action: Use known-good Agent/Hub pair or SSH fallback until fixed.

title: Fresh response struct prevents stale fields
failure_mode: Fields omitted in a later response retain stale values from an earlier CBOR response.
trigger_or_prerequisite: Optional field is omitted after being nonzero or fetch paths overlap.
affected_data_security_functionality: Current system state, charts, and alerts.
mitigation: Decode each response into a fresh struct and replace cached state under synchronization.
required_test: Send nonzero then omitted/zero fields through overlapping realtime and scheduled fetches.
rollback_containment_action: Disable affected data path or revert compatible pair; retain stored history.

title: Async WebSocket handshake stops reconnect
failure_mode: Agent stays disconnected after asynchronous handshake failure.
trigger_or_prerequisite: Hub rejects/interrupts handshake or network fails during upgrade.
mitigation: Synchronize connecting state and return failed handshake to retry state.
required_test: Inject failed handshakes followed by success.
rollback_containment_action: Restart Agent only as containment; restore known-good binary if retries stall.

title: SSH handshake has bounded deadline
failure_mode: Silent SSH peer holds updater or transport indefinitely.
trigger_or_prerequisite: Peer accepts TCP but does not complete handshake.
mitigation: Bound handshake and clear deadline after success.
required_test: Silent peer times out within budget; later poll succeeds.
rollback_containment_action: Cancel affected poll and close transport; other systems keep polling.

title: System status access race
failure_mode: Concurrent polling, reconnect, and alert transitions publish inconsistent status.
trigger_or_prerequisite: Multiple goroutines read/write status during polling or alerts.
affected_data_security_functionality: Up/down state, alerts, and polling decisions.
mitigation: Use synchronized status accessors for all reads/writes.
required_test: Concurrent status/alert transition tests with race detector.
rollback_containment_action: Restart affected Hub only after verified backup if inconsistent state persists.

title: WebSocket connection lifecycle race
failure_mode: Close, poll, and reconnect race over connection pointer or reuse a closed connection.
trigger_or_prerequisite: Concurrent close and reconnect or multiple lifecycle goroutines.
affected_data_security_functionality: Agent connection stability and request correctness.
mitigation: Synchronize connection pointer/lifecycle and define replacement ownership.
required_test: Rapid connect/close/request/reconnect race test.
rollback_containment_action: Close affected connection and allow clean reconnect.

title: Monitor result ownership isolation
failure_mode: One system writes another system’s monitor result or history by supplying a monitor ID.
trigger_or_prerequisite: Monitor ID belongs to a different reporting system.
affected_data_security_functionality: Cross-system telemetry integrity and tenant isolation.
mitigation: Constrain DB/realtime/history writes by monitor ID and reporting system; check ownership before update.
required_test: Attempt cross-system stats, realtime update, and history insertion.
rollback_containment_action: Disable monitor writes if ownership checks fail; retain DB backup and audit evidence.

title: Alert authorization and delivery boundary
failure_mode: Alert subscription/delivery exposes a system the user cannot access or allows owner/system reassignment.
trigger_or_prerequisite: Alert API, queue, history, evaluation, or membership revocation occurs.
affected_data_security_functionality: Private telemetry, alert destinations, user/system ownership.
mitigation: Reapply collection rules at startup; recheck access for CRUD, queued delivery, subscriptions, and history.
required_test: Two-user access matrix through API, queue, cache, history, membership revoke.
rollback_containment_action: Disable delivery and restore pre-upgrade DB/binary if access invariants fail.

title: Auth-sensitive response cached by proxy
failure_mode: Shared proxy serves systemd details across authenticated users.
trigger_or_prerequisite: Proxy or browser caches API response without user variance.
mitigation: Set private cache policy and `Vary: Authorization`.
required_test: Assert headers and exercise two credentials through shared-cache fixture.
rollback_containment_action: Disable endpoint caching or systemd detail route until headers are correct.

title: SSH request cancellation leaves in-flight work
failure_mode: Canceled polling leaves a live session or blocked goroutine.
trigger_or_prerequisite: Caller deadline/cancel occurs during SSH request.
mitigation: Propagate cancellation to close connection/session and serialize ownership.
required_test: Cancel at each request stage; assert prompt return and no retained session.
rollback_containment_action: Close affected SSH transport and reconnect cleanly.

title: Competing SSH connection owners
failure_mode: Polling, ZFS, and monitor sync open competing connections and disrupt each other.
trigger_or_prerequisite: Multiple SSH consumers operate during reconnect.
affected_data_security_functionality: Transport integrity, monitor sync, ZFS and stats.
mitigation: Make SSHTransport sole owner and route all callers through it.
required_test: Concurrent polling/reconnect/monitor/ZFS asserts one replacement connection.
rollback_containment_action: Close sessions and reconnect via single manager after rollback if needed.

title: WebSocket to SSH fallback lifecycle
failure_mode: Agent sticks or serves stale connections after WebSocket failure; shared source edit drops iOS hook.
trigger_or_prerequisite: Fallback/reconnect callbacks overlap during upstream merge.
affected_data_security_functionality: Telemetry availability and iOS system metadata.
mitigation: Preserve listener cleanup/reconnect and protect `adjustPlatformSystemDetails` hook.
required_test: WebSocket→SSH fallback→disconnect→reconnect; compare iOS metadata.
rollback_containment_action: Restart Agent with known-good config and restore protected iOS patch.

title: Duplicate payload breaks legacy Hub framing
failure_mode: Older Hub reads unexpected extra stats payload or new Agent drops expected one-shot payload.
trigger_or_prerequisite: New Agent connects to older Hub using legacy response protocol.
mitigation: Keep exactly one legacy response and version-selected serialization.
required_test: Pair 0.21 Agent with 0.19 Hub fixture; assert one payload and successful ingest.
rollback_containment_action: Return both binaries to last known compatible pair; preserve Agent config/token.

title: Slow Agent expires between Hub polls
failure_mode: Healthy slow Agent disconnects during long collection.
trigger_or_prerequisite: Collection exceeds idle gap between polls.
mitigation: Ping between polls while active; separate data and idle deadlines.
required_test: Slow collector fixture verifies ping, connection, and eventual stats.
rollback_containment_action: Use SSH fallback or reduce load while restoring compatible binaries.

title: Keepalive masks a silent Agent
failure_mode: Pings continue after Agent stops sending messages, hiding a stale peer.
trigger_or_prerequisite: Transport responds to pings although Agent is silent.
mitigation: Stop pings after documented three-minute silence and reconnect stale peers.
required_test: Silent-peer cutoff test plus active slow-collection control case.
rollback_containment_action: Close stale peer and allow fresh Agent reconnect.

title: JSON v2 zero-value serialization drift
failure_mode: Zero/false fields differ among JSON v1/v2, CBOR, older peers, and clients.
trigger_or_prerequisite: Payload crosses versions or JSON v2 is enabled.
affected_data_security_functionality: Stats, API shape, frontend, and alert evaluation.
mitigation: Retain `omitzero`; test missing, explicit zero, false, empty values in JSON v1/v2 and CBOR.
required_test: Golden contract tests for Agent/API/persisted records.
rollback_containment_action: Disable affected serialization path or roll back both ends; do not rewrite history.

title: Migration order and PocketBase ledger
failure_mode: Migration ordering repeats a removed one-off step or applies a collection snapshot before dependencies exist.
trigger_or_prerequisite: 0.19 DB starts the 0.21 Hub; migrations register in startup and PocketBase tracks them.
mitigation: Check registered order/ledger on fresh and migrated copies; second startup must be idempotent.
required_test: Offline upgrade with injected interruption between migration steps.
rollback_containment_action: Stop Hub; restore full pre-migration snapshot and prior binary.

title: Monitor records, fields, indexes, history migrations
failure_mode: Monitor/certificate/server/TLS-option or ZFS schema changes fail or break relations/indexes.
trigger_or_prerequisite: Migration creates monitor/history collections or adds fields/indexes.
mitigation: Compare fields, indexes, IDs, relations, counts, retention on synthetic data.
required_test: Migrate then create/update/delete monitor and query history.
rollback_containment_action: Restore complete backup before old Hub; leave monitors disabled until validated.

title: History rollup, retention, and preservation
failure_mode: New monitor rollups or scheduled retention delete, skip, or mis-average system, container, monitor, or alert history; the first hourly deletion after upgrade removes aged data according to the v0.21 policy.
trigger_or_prerequisite: Hub startup schedules record rollups every 10 minutes and deletion at minute 8 of each hour; old or new records cross 1m/10m/20m/120m/480m retention boundaries.
affected_data_security_functionality: Historical metrics and alert history; monitor aggregate counts/response sums.
mitigation: Record exact 0.21 retention tiers (1m=1h, 10m=12h, 20m=1d, 120m=7d, 480m=30d; alert history keeps latest 200 once >250); use a controlled clock and fixture values on each boundary.
required_test: Verify per-monitor aggregation through all tiers and retention cutoffs for system/container/monitor stats plus per-user alert history, without deleting pre-upgrade fixture history unexpectedly.
rollback_containment_action: Restore complete backup; do not attempt ad hoc production row rollback.

title: User/account/system ownership preservation
failure_mode: Existing roles, system relations, settings, or alert ownership change during collection/rule updates.
trigger_or_prerequisite: Collection snapshot or auth-rule startup hook runs on 0.19 data.
mitigation: Assert stable IDs/relations; exercise owner/system rules with multiple fixture users.
required_test: Before/after invariant diff and multi-user API authorization matrix.
rollback_containment_action: Restore full snapshot and old binary; restrict access pending inspection.

title: Existing 0.19.0 data preservation
failure_mode: Upgrade loses or strands accounts, config, SSH key, systems, or history.
trigger_or_prerequisite: 0.21 Hub opens `/var/lib/beszel-hub` or installer replaces binary before verified restore point.
affected_data_security_functionality: All persistent Hub database and application state.
mitigation: Cold full backup outside staging; migrate only disposable copy; demonstrate full restore before production approval.
required_test: Seed 0.19 fixture, upgrade, invariant check, restore under 0.19, interrupted-start recovery.
rollback_containment_action: Stop Agent and Hub; restore data, binary, service plist, and install state together.

title: Inconsistent SQLite backup or incomplete restore set
failure_mode: Copying only `data.db` while writers run omits WAL state; missing auxiliary files, keys, config, permissions, or ownership breaks restore.
trigger_or_prerequisite: Hub/writer remains active or sidecars/application state are excluded.
affected_data_security_functionality: Accounts, config, systems, history, keys, migration ledger, app state.
mitigation: Stop Agent then Hub; verify exit; archive entire data directory and service/config/binary state; hash and demonstrate restore.
required_test: Cold archive/hash check and disposable restore; SQLite quick_check on a copy if tooling exists.
rollback_containment_action: Do not start any Hub against questionable copy; retain original and restore verified snapshot.

title: Apple A7 illegal instruction
failure_mode: A7 executes CNTVCT_EL0 or another unsupported instruction and process exits SIGILL.
trigger_or_prerequisite: Go runtime/assembler changes or runtime patch mismatch.
affected_data_security_functionality: Agent and Hub availability on A7/iOS 12.5.7.
mitigation: Patch only verified source shape; reject unknown shape; inspect binary and launch both on device.
required_test: A7 build plus repeated physical launch, load, collection, reconnect.
rollback_containment_action: Stop new binaries; restore verified 0.19 binaries without touching data.

title: Unexpected Go runtime source/patch shape
failure_mode: Patch edits wrong function or leaves unsafe instruction in output.
trigger_or_prerequisite: Go version changes assembly markers/source.
mitigation: Retain exact marker/count checks; unknown shapes fail closed; archive toolchain and patch diff.
required_test: Negative tests with changed markers plus patched output inspection.
rollback_containment_action: Reject artifact and rebuild from pinned known toolchain.

title: Darwin/iOS build-tag selection
failure_mode: iOS selects macOS implementation, excludes iOS file, or compiles conflicting implementations.
trigger_or_prerequisite: Upstream `darwin`/`!linux` constraints merge without iOS audit.
mitigation: Audit `go list` file sets for ios/darwin/Linux/Windows; add explicit iOS exclusions where required.
required_test: GOOS file-selection manifest and compile selection tests for both binaries.
rollback_containment_action: Reject candidate artifacts and retain current iOS binaries.

title: Upstream system collector drops iOS metadata hook
failure_mode: iOS OS name/kernel/model/CPU/thread fields fall back to generic or incorrect values.
trigger_or_prerequisite: Upstream `agent/system.go` replaces current platform hook call.
mitigation: Preserve iOS hook/platform file and compare metadata on A1489 with 0.19 reference.
required_test: Payload fixture and physical sysctl/plist comparison.
rollback_containment_action: Restore prior Agent binary; no DB restore needed for metadata-only failure.

title: macOS battery collector selected for iOS
failure_mode: iOS build selects `AppleSmartBattery -a` collector or conflicts with iOS `AppleARMPMUCharger -l` parser.
trigger_or_prerequisite: `darwin` also matches ios and upstream drops `!ios` guard.
mitigation: Keep iOS parser and constrain macOS collector to `darwin && !ios`; verify selected files.
required_test: Tag audit, iOS parser fixtures and physical charge-state matrix.
rollback_containment_action: Reject upgraded Agent and restore verified old binary/parser.

title: Battery parser or charge-state regression
failure_mode: Legacy ioreg prefixes/nested fields or attachment/charging/full state are parsed incorrectly.
trigger_or_prerequisite: Output shape or device charging state differs from fixture.
mitigation: Preserve top-level key matching, `-l`, clamp and explicit state map; never assume macOS `-a` works.
required_test: Legacy output fixtures and unplugged/charging/idle/full/empty device cases.
rollback_containment_action: Disable battery field if parse confidence fails; never synthesize percentage.

title: macOS osascript Wi-Fi is not iOS RSSI support
failure_mode: iOS attempts `/usr/bin/osascript`, emits fake/stale RSSI, or unsupported fallback emits zero.
trigger_or_prerequisite: Darwin JXA/CoreWLAN collector is treated as iOS support.
mitigation: Explicitly exclude iOS from macOS collector; until P012 adapter, use absent/no-op and show unavailable.
required_test: Tag test and absent-field contract; hardware only if native adapter is selected.
rollback_containment_action: Disable iOS RSSI only; retain other network counters and Hub display.

title: Procursus/APT adapter absent or blocked
failure_mode: Package check blocks metrics, mutates package state, or fails to recognize installed manager.
trigger_or_prerequisite: Future iOS adapter uses unsupported flags, stale lists, permissions, or lacks timeout.
affected_data_security_functionality: Package telemetry and Agent responsiveness; package database.
mitigation: P011 adapter must be read-only, bounded, detect installed manager and return absent on unsupported commands; never refresh/install.
required_test: Procursus/APT fixtures, timeout/hung-child case, package DB hash unchanged.
rollback_containment_action: Disable adapter and report absent; do not call update/install.

title: Unsupported collectors return misleading iOS values
failure_mode: Linux/macOS/Windows GPU, SMART, ZFS, systemd, container, CPU/RAM/disk paths panic, block, mislabel, or appear as measured zero.
trigger_or_prerequisite: Broad build tag or generic fallback maps unsupported capability to zero.
affected_data_security_functionality: Metric correctness, Agent stability, remote platform parity.
mitigation: P010/P008 define exclusions/adapters; absent capability stays absent; preserve Hub support for remote OS.
required_test: iOS package selection and per-collector absent contract plus Linux/Windows/macOS regression tests.
rollback_containment_action: Disable only unsupported local collector; preserve supported counters and remote telemetry.

title: Network interface counters change semantics
failure_mode: Counters reset, duplicate, overflow, or include unexpected tunnel/loopback interfaces.
trigger_or_prerequisite: Interface enumeration differs under jailbreak, VPN, or upstream collector change.
mitigation: Test stable interface identity, monotonic deltas, reset and unsupported behavior.
required_test: A7 loopback/Wi-Fi/VPN/counter-reset fixture and remote OS regression.
rollback_containment_action: Disable affected interface reporting; retain raw history and do not rewrite samples.

title: Installer rollback/uninstall touches persistent Hub data
failure_mode: Rollback restores binary but leaves incompatible DB, or uninstall/purge removes `/var/lib/beszel-hub`.
trigger_or_prerequisite: Update, repair, rollback, uninstall, or failed start surrounds a migration.
affected_data_security_functionality: Accounts, config, SSH key, systems, history, DB and sidecars.
mitigation: Reconcile installer transaction with explicit data restore; ordinary rollback preserves data; purge remains explicit.
required_test: Installer failpoints around Hub startup with disposable migrated DB and path sentinels.
rollback_containment_action: Stop Agent then Hub; restore data, binary, plist and install state from verified backup.

title: iOS event triggers upstream release jobs
failure_mode: iOS tag/PR starts Docker publish or upstream release workflow.
trigger_or_prerequisite: Workflow tag/path filters overlap upstream events.
affected_data_security_functionality: Release supply chain and unintended public artifacts.
mitigation: Keep iOS filters isolated; inspect events/permissions; P003 creates no tag/deploy.
required_test: Static event matrix for iOS branch/tag and upstream tags; dry-run workflow tests.
rollback_containment_action: Cancel publication and contain unintended artifacts under incident review.

title: Bootstrap checksum/pin installs wrong engine
failure_mode: Bootstrap executes modified engine or accepts wrong architecture/deployment binary.
trigger_or_prerequisite: Release URL, tag, pin, or checksum is malformed/stale.
mitigation: Pin engine SHA/tag; verify checksum before execution and A7/deployment metadata before install.
required_test: Tampered hash, wrong arch, stale pin, interrupted download, known-good payload cases.
rollback_containment_action: Abort before install; preserve installed binaries/data and restore verified bootstrap.

title: Service order or reboot persistence fails
failure_mode: Agent starts before Hub; stop order is wrong; LaunchDaemons fail after jailbreak reactivation.
trigger_or_prerequisite: Install/update/reconfigure/uninstall/reboot transaction.
mitigation: Start Hub before Agent; stop Agent before Hub; validate labels and reactivation procedure.
required_test: Install/update/repair/reconfigure/uninstall-no-purge and reboot/reactivation on A7.
rollback_containment_action: Restore plist/binary pair; start Hub then Agent after health check.

title: Frontend/API model mismatch
failure_mode: Frontend assumes missing API fields/routes or handles JSON omission incorrectly.
trigger_or_prerequisite: Backend/API and frontend batches integrate separately or JSON v2 changes zero fields.
affected_data_security_functionality: Dashboard, alert and monitor UI; persisted telemetry may continue.
mitigation: Build type/API fixtures against exact Hub version with absent/new/old record variants.
required_test: P014 frontend tests and Hub API snapshots on candidate build.
rollback_containment_action: Restore prior Hub/frontend binary pair or disable affected route without changing data.

title: Missing or stale embedded frontend assets
failure_mode: Hub starts with missing/stale `dist` files after frontend/API changes.
trigger_or_prerequisite: Bun build/embed step skipped or stale.
mitigation: Require deterministic site build before Go embed; verify artifact asset manifest/hash.
required_test: Clean Bun install/build, embed manifest, Hub startup/browser smoke.
rollback_containment_action: Restore previous Hub binary with its embedded assets; leave DB untouched.

title: Bun lockfile incompatibility
failure_mode: Clean frontend dependency install resolves differently or fails.
trigger_or_prerequisite: Bun version/lockfile diverges or npm lock is used.
affected_data_security_functionality: Reproducible Hub assets and dependency set.
mitigation: Pin Bun and use frozen lockfile; P003 does not upgrade dependencies.
required_test: Clean runner install with pinned Bun and lockfile integrity check.
rollback_containment_action: Stop release candidate and return to last verified lock/toolchain.

title: Frozen dependency advisories remain unresolved
failure_mode: A known vulnerable dependency remains at frozen target or an unreviewed dependency enters integration.
trigger_or_prerequisite: Advisory exists in target lockfiles or dependency changes are mixed into sync.
affected_data_security_functionality: Agent/Hub attack surface and artifact trust.
mitigation: Inventory Go/Bun advisories at P015/P017; triage findings and do authorized updates in the assigned prompt.
required_test: Dated Go module and frontend lock audit with severity disposition.
rollback_containment_action: Block release candidate; keep current production binaries pending dependency review.

title: iOS exclusions regress remote Agent telemetry
failure_mode: Hub no longer stores/displays supported remote Linux/Windows/macOS fields.
trigger_or_prerequisite: Shared entities/API/frontend become coupled to local iOS collector tags.
mitigation: Keep Hub protocol/storage independent from local build tags; exercise three remote OS fixtures.
required_test: Linux/Windows/macOS Agent fixtures through iOS Hub for metrics, alerts, monitor history, frontend.
rollback_containment_action: Revert local collector/model changes while keeping safe Hub service online.

title: P017 evidence, sync CI, and documentation drift
failure_mode: Stale port documentation, missing sentinel coverage, or sync CI hides loss of a protected patch or an untested claim.
trigger_or_prerequisite: Upstream history changes an audited path or P017 updates checks/evidence without reconciling P002 artifacts.
affected_data_security_functionality: Auditability, patch preservation, CI confidence, and operator expectations.
mitigation: Keep P002 audit evidence immutable; update canonical crosswalk and sentinels; separate historical 0.19 evidence from planned 0.21 status.
required_test: Run upstream-sync and patch-sentinel suites; review release/validation documentation against current artifacts.
rollback_containment_action: Stop integration and restore the missing protected files/CI checks before continuing.
